purpose: Requalify the same direct C2B representable-state to Ross table-coordinate mapping after the strict R0 gate showed that the formula itself is high-precision accurate but h->binary64 S representability produces roundtrip error far below table resolution. R1 adds an exact physical join mapping and expresses the head-origin roundtrip bound relative to the actual N241 table cell width.

roundtrip_acceptance_rationale.reason: The roundtrip term measures finite representability of the water-content state generated from head, not error in the direct state-to-coordinate formula. Requiring this perturbation below one hundred-millionth of an interpolation cell makes it negligible relative to any table discretization while retaining a deterministic quantitative gate.
roundtrip_acceptance_rationale.downstream_guard: The subsequent face-table gate retains the original frozen flux-error criteria and therefore independently catches any coordinate perturbation that matters physically.

test_set: Reuse the R0 deterministic endpoints, nextafter, uniform-state, log-head-origin, join-focused and 80-digit reference probes without retuning probe locations.

exit_rule.pass: Freeze R1 as the C2B bounded runtime state-to-coordinate mapping and open the separately contracted steady-face representation characterization.
exit_rule.fail: Fail-close R1. Do not weaken the downstream face-flux criteria or add runtime root finding.

scope_guard: Mapping only for h=[-10000,-1] cm and N241 candidate resolution. No h>-1, saturation switching, transient solver, groundwater or production claim.
